tasks.label: Export OpenAPI to YAML
args: mkdir -p ${workspaceFolder}/docs && curl -s http://localhost:8000/openapi.json | python3 -c "import sys, json, yaml; print(yaml.dump(json.load(sys.stdin), default_flow_style=False, sort_keys=False))" > ${workspaceFolder}/docs/openapi.yaml && echo 'OpenAPI spec written to docs/openapi.yaml'

tasks.label: Assert Head is Clean
tasks.command: git -C "${workspaceFolder}" diff --quiet && git -C "${workspaceFolder}" diff --cached --quiet || (echo 'ERROR: Working tree is not clean. Commit or stash all changes before releasing.' && exit 1)

tasks.label: Assert Main Branch
tasks.command: [ "$(git -C "${workspaceFolder}" branch --show-current)" = "main" ] || (echo 'ERROR: Must be on main to release.' && exit 1)

tasks.label: Stop Kubernetes
args: helm uninstall ai-assistant 2>/dev/null && echo 'Release uninstalled.' || echo 'No release to uninstall.'; minikube stop
